retrieved.title: Fictional border-document checklist
retrieved.text: For missing border paperwork in this demonstration, collect the certificate of origin and supporting invoice, then ask the document owner to review completeness. Do not invent a clearance time. This fictional checklist is not customs or legal advice.

retrieved.title: Substitute material approval
retrieved.text: Before accepting a substitute material, obtain written engineering change approval and confirm the required specification. A supplier proposal is not approval. Keep the alternative on hold until the authorized reviewer responds.
